name: Purple Grapemash No. 3

source.note: The Wizard of Wines' cheapest wine; price as the PHB's common wine.

summary: A bottle of the Martikovs' everyday red: thin, sour and faintly purple.
text: The wine every tavern in Barovia pours, when the carts come. It does nothing for you but warm you, and it barely does that.
